insights.headline: Gold firms near $4,150 as Fed hike bets hold; Kalyan Jewellers rallies on Jefferies outlook.
insights.summary: Spot gold held near $4,150 an ounce on Friday as a softer dollar and easing yields offset hawkish Fed signals — St. Louis Fed's Musalem said another hike is needed, with traders pricing an 18% chance in October and about 80% in December. In India, Kalyan Jewellers extended a three-month 55% rally after a strong Q2 revenue update, with Jefferies seeing 46% further upside, while MCX gold stayed near ₹1.49 lakh per 10 grams and the 3% IGST on bank bullion imports was confirmed in force since April.
points: Spot gold near $4,150; US futures near $4,190; Comex settled $4,131.80 on Oct 8; spot silver $59.6.
Kalyan Jewellers +55% in 3 months on Q2 revenue +46% YoY; Jefferies 'Buy', ₹830 target.
MCX December gold near ₹1.49 lakh/10g; December silver near ₹2.20 lakh/kg; ₹1.44L key support.
Banks pay 3% IGST on bullion imports since April 1; rupee at 96.79, 1-year forward premium 8.65%.
Gold ETFs drew a record $31B in Q3; PBOC bought ~23 tonnes in September, 23rd straight month.

trending.title: Gold firms near $4,150 as traders weigh Fed hike bets
trending.summary: Bullion held its rebound from a two-month low as a softer dollar and easing yields offset hawkish Fed signals; traders price 18% odds of an October hike and about 80% for December.

trending.title: MCX gold steady near Rs 1.49 lakh; silver under pressure
trending.summary: December gold on MCX held near Rs 1.49 lakh per 10 grams while December silver slipped to Rs 2.20 lakh per kg; analysts see Rs 1.44 lakh as key support and $4,000 as the next global floor.

trending.title: Jewellers ride festive demand ahead of Dhanteras
trending.summary: Kalyan Jewellers extended a 55% three-month rally after strong Q2 revenue growth, with Jefferies seeing 46% further upside; Senco Gold jumped over 9% on a 31% YoY revenue rise.

trending.title: Bank bullion channel faces 3% IGST as rupee defense gets costlier
trending.summary: Banks have paid 3% IGST on bullion imports since April, raising working-capital costs; RBI sell-buy swaps slowed the rupee's slide to 96.79 but pushed one-year forward premiums to 8.65%.

items.title: Gold rises on softer dollar, easing yields; Fed outlook in focus
items.summary: Spot gold rose 0.9% to $4,169.32 by 0137 GMT on Friday, recovering from a two-month low as a softer dollar and easing Treasury yields lifted bullion; US futures gained 0.9% to $4,194.40. St. Louis Fed's Musalem said another hike is needed to curb inflation, with traders pricing an 18% chance of an October hike and 82% for December. Spot silver rose 1.1% to $60.00.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers shares shine: 55% up in 3 months, Jefferies India sees further 46% upside
items.summary: Kalyan Jewellers' shares are up about 55% in three months after a strong Q2 FY27 revenue update: consolidated revenue rose 46% year-on-year to Rs 10,588.9 crore and international revenue grew around 18%. Jefferies initiated coverage with a 'Buy' rating and a Rs 830 target, for about 46% upside. The jeweller also sold a non-core property for Rs 86 crore, cutting non-gold-metal-loan debt to zero.

items.title: India ends IGST relief on bank bullion imports; 3% tax applies since April
items.summary: Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava said banks have paid 3% IGST on gold and precious-metal imports since April 1, 2026, after the 2017 exemption was not extended. The decision, placed before the GST Council this week, puts banks and nominated agencies on the same tax footing as bullion exchanges. The levy is paid upfront and claimed as input tax credit, raising working-capital costs.

items.title: Gold steady near ₹1.49 lakh per 10 grams on MCX; silver under pressur: Key levels to watch
items.summary: MCX December gold held near ₹1.49 lakh per 10 grams on Thursday, up 0.07%, while December silver fell 1.24% to ₹2.20 lakh per kg. Analysts cited a firm dollar, Fed rate-hike expectations and elevated crude; Anand Rathi's Vedika Narvekar sees a near-term downward bias with support near ₹1.44 lakh, while IBJA's Prithviraj Kothari flagged $4,000 an ounce as the next key level for gold.

items.title: Comex gold settles 0.44% higher at $4,131.80 as traders digest Fed minutes
items.summary: Gold futures recovered from a two-month low on October 8 as traders digested September FOMC minutes showing most policymakers expect another rate hike by year-end. December gold rose 0.5% to $4,161.10 while the front-month contract settled 0.44% higher at $4,131.80; silver fell 1.1% to $59.62. Markets priced an 18% chance of an October hike and about 80% for December, per the CME FedWatch tool.

items.title: Gold Recovers as Chinese Buyers Return From Weeklong Holiday
items.summary: Gold rebounded from a two-month low as Chinese buyers returned after the weeklong holiday, though prices were still headed for a third weekly loss. The PBOC added about 23 tonnes in September, its biggest monthly purchase since 2023, and central bankers meeting in Italy highlighted gold's reserve-diversification role. Spot gold rose 0.3% to $4,122.28; silver fell 1.4% to $58.94.

items.title: Silver's long-term outlook remains bullish as new investment products offer income opportunities
items.summary: Amplify ETFs' Nate Miller says silver's long-term uptrend is intact: spot near $59 an ounce is down on the day but well above last year's roughly $50, supported by solar and industrial demand. New covered-call ETF products let investors earn income from the non-yielding metal, broadening its buyer base.

items.title: Gold ETFs drew a record $31 billion in Q3; holdings hit an all-time high
items.summary: World Gold Council data shows global physically-backed gold ETFs attracted $10 billion in September, capping a record $31 billion third quarter. Holdings rose 67 tonnes to a record 4,256 tonnes even as gold fell 8.5% in September; assets under management slipped 7% month-on-month to $574 billion on the lower price. The US led inflows; UK funds had their strongest quarter on record.

items.title: Gold, silver futures: Vandana Bharti on what’s capping upside on precious metals, range to watch
items.summary: SMC Global Securities' Vandana Bharti said elevated crude prices, bond yields and a firmer dollar are capping gold's upside, with support near $4,090 and resistance at $4,200; she expects the broader uptrend to resume once the rise in bond yields pauses. She sees MCX gold in a ₹1,45,000–₹1,52,000 range and MCX silver between ₹2,20,000 and ₹2,30,000 per kg.

items.title: RBI's sell-buy swaps slow rupee's fall but push up forward premiums, making hedging costlier for foreign investors
items.summary: The RBI's sell-buy swaps — selling dollars spot with a promise to buy back later — slowed the rupee's slide but pushed the one-year dollar-rupee forward premium to 8.65% from 7.40% under a month ago, raising hedging costs for foreign investors and potentially discouraging debt and portfolio inflows. The rupee closed at 96.79 per dollar, near its 96.96 record low, as Brent jumped to $104 a barrel.

items.title: Senco Gold Share Price Gains Over 9% After Q2 FY27 Performance Report
items.summary: Senco Gold's shares jumped over 9% after its Q2 FY27 update showed total revenue up 31% YoY and retail revenue up 29%, with same-store sales growth of 19%. The jeweller crossed Rs 5,000 crore in H1 revenue and Rs 10,000 crore on a trailing twelve-month basis; diamond jewellery revenue grew 31% in value. Six new showrooms took the network to 215 stores.
